title: Nick's Pro Fitness

services.name: Self Defense
services.desc: Nick Kapande, owner of Nick’s Pro Fitness gym in North Bend, has been leading self-defense seminars since 1982. In “I WILL FIGHT BACK”, students learn methods to protect themselves in dangerous situations; more importantly, students learn that they can fight back. This seminar also covers the psychological and physical aspects of self-defense. Moves are practiced with a partner and observed by Nick to ensure correct technique. Learn more about Nick here. This popular and empowering Self-Defense program is appropriate for all fitness levels, ages 10 and up. Students complete “I Will Fight Back” with the knowledge and the will to fight back, and are welcome to audit future self-defense
